implementation.compaction_repair: Repeated context fitting preserves an existing governance rules_ref rather than replacing it with null.
implementation.digest_handling: Only canonical sha256:<64 lowercase hex> input digests are attached. Missing or malformed digests remain null and their context lineage edges remain referenced/unavailable.

projection_contract.diagnostics: types review code, evidence reference, summary, and remedy
projection_contract.governance: types authority identity, allow-listed rights/provenance/agent rules, and compact rules_ref fallback
projection_contract.provenance: types origin and declaration state, counts, bounded relationship kinds, and referenced/observed/unavailable lineage edges
projection_contract.rights: types declared source summaries, unknown compatibility, license and truncation states

reference_compaction.action_guidance: Compact projection may omit redundant per-action status entries when they equal the shared status; query_ref and expression_ref remain.
reference_compaction.authoritative_references: Long manifest and governance references stay once in sources; repeated locations resolve through source:<key> and its source record.
reference_compaction.lineage: Compact edges may omit repeated output targets and reference the source digest already held in sources.

limits: The context projection remains evidence-oriented and makes no legal compatibility, ownership, authorship, or contributor-authority conclusion.
This change types the Rights provider output; Environment admission and cache invalidation remain a separate integration scope.
No operative license text or candidate terms were changed.

context_budget_probe.result: within budget; compact aliases preserve authoritative references and lineage digest references
